incoming.name: Chew Valley
incoming.excerpt: Larger birds include Woodpeckers (Picidae) and Common Buzzard (Buteo buteo).

incoming.name: Mount Rushmore
incoming.excerpt: Smaller birds, including songbirds, nuthatches, and woodpeckers, inhabit the surrounding pine forests.

incoming.name: Paleocene
incoming.excerpt: Most modern bird types had appeared by mid-Cenozoic, including perching birds, cranes, hawks, pelicans, herons, owls, ducks, pigeons, loons, and woodpeckers.

incoming.name: Slovenia
incoming.excerpt: Other birds include (both black and green) woodpeckers and the white stork which nests in Prekmurje.

outgoing.name: Canada
outgoing.excerpt: In February 2005 the Canadian scientist Dr Louis Lefebvre announced a method of measuring avian IQ in terms of their innovation in feeding habits.

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: The term " Peckerwood", an inversion of "Woodpecker", is used as a pejorative term in the United States.
